source.notes: arch-053. The attention branch is plain causal U1.S with a GQA-capable head map (n_query_groups) and external RoPE — verified against lit_gpt/model.py CausalSelfAttention @ 617c7a0f. The per-layer mixer selection (use_mamba/use_retnet/use_gla schedules) and the mamba_swa_mlp Mamba-then-attention block mode are gated on the Mamba selective-SSM axis (A8) and are NOT claimed here; this module is the attention branch only. Layer module: architectures/samba_attention.py.

coverage.notes: Attention-branch parity vs the pinned CausalSelfAttention (MHA and GQA query-group configs, RoPE injected) in tests/test_architectures_samba.py; gradients flow through the QKV and output projections. The per-layer Mamba/RetNet/GLA schedule, the mamba_swa_mlp block mode (Mamba axis A8), the optional short-conv (sc_attn), local sliding window and KV-cache/decode paths are residual external work, not claimed.
